name: Introduction to Chemical Engineering
description: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to chemical engineering, historical evolution, and interdisciplinary connections with fields like biotechnology, materials science, environmental engineering, and data science. Students will explore real-world applications in chemical industries, while gaining insights into emerging trends. The course also highlights the ethical responsibilities and societal impacts of chemical engineering, preparing students to address global challenges.
